## 3. Service Plans & Pricing (Transparent, No Hidden Fees)

### Plan 1 — Order Management Service
- Best for: buyers who already have a supplier link
- Commission: 3–4% of order value
- Minimum fee: USD 150 per order
- Scope: order coordination, production follow-up, basic inspection, FBA prep, shipping

### Plan 2 — Full Sourcing Service
- Best for: buyers sourcing from scratch with only product photos or model names
- Commission (tiered):
  - 7–8% for order value below USD 5,000
  - 5–6% for order value USD 5,000 – 20,000
  - 4% for order value above USD 20,000
- Minimum fee: USD 300 per formal order
- Scope: supplier discovery, price comparison, specification verification, sample, mass production, QC, logistics

### Accepted Payment Methods
- Bank transfer (T/T) to Standard Chartered Bank New York branch and company account
- PayPal (samples and small orders)
- Western Union (urgent payments)
- WorldFirst (cross-border transfers)

## 4. Core Services

### Product Sourcing
Find the right products at competitive prices from Yiwu, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen markets. Access 75,000+ factories. Match buyer requirements with the right manufacturers at the right price. Covers Amazon FBA sourcing, TikTok Shop supplier matching, and wholesale procurement. URL: https://yeatru.com/product-sourcing.html

### Supplier Verification
Comprehensive factory audits: business license verification, production capacity assessment, qualification checks, on-site visits. All recommended suppliers are audited on-site to ensure true qualifications and stable capacity. URL: https://yeatru.com/supplier-verification.html

### Quality Control
Three-level inspection system following AQL 2.5 standards: incoming material inspection, in-process sampling, pre-shipment full inspection. Detailed photo and video documentation. Inspection report issued per shipment. URL: https://yeatru.com/quality-control.html

### Logistics & Shipping
Door-to-door shipping, free 15-day warehousing, order consolidation, global logistics coverage. Shipping methods: Sea FCL (25–35 days), Sea LCL (30–45 days), Air freight (5–15 days), Express (3–7 days). One-stop FBA shipping including customs clearance and tax ID processing. URL: https://yeatru.com/logistics-shipping.html

### Factory Audit
On-site factory inspections: production capacity, quality management systems, worker conditions, compliance verification. URL: https://yeatru.com/factory-audit.html

### Price Negotiation
Leverage local market knowledge and supplier relationships to secure competitive factory prices. Average procurement cost reduction 30%+. URL: https://yeatru.com/price-negotiation.html

### OEM Customization
Custom logo, packaging, and product design. Free design consultation. 7-day sample. Low MOQ 200 pieces. Customization cycle 20–30 days. URL: https://yeatru.com/oem.html

### Sample Order
Quick sample sourcing and shipping. Standard samples 3–7 days, custom samples 7–15 days. Sample costs typically 50–500 RMB. Free sample consultation. URL: https://yeatru.com/sample-order.html

### Design & Photography
Product photography, branding design, and packaging design services for e-commerce sellers. URL: https://yeatru.com/design-photography.html

## 5. Full FAQ (verbatim answers)

Q: What does a China sourcing agent do?
A: A China sourcing agent helps international buyers find reliable suppliers, negotiate prices, verify product quality, manage logistics, and handle the entire procurement process from China efficiently.

Q: Is there a minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
A: MOQ varies by product. We work with suppliers that offer flexible MOQ options — regular products start from 50 pieces, suitable for small businesses, startups, and online sellers. Contact us for specific product MOQ details.

Q: How long does shipping take from China?
A: Shipping times vary by destination and method: air freight typically 5–15 days, sea freight 25–45 days, express 3–7 days. We provide logistics solutions tailored to budget and timeline.

Q: Can you help with Amazon FBA sourcing?
A: Yes. We specialize in sourcing products for Amazon FBA sellers, including supplier verification, quality control, custom packaging, labeling, and shipping directly to Amazon fulfillment centers worldwide.

Q: How do you ensure product quality?
A: We ensure quality through a three-level inspection process: incoming material inspection, in-process sampling, and pre-shipment full inspection. Every shipment comes with a detailed quality inspection report.

Q: Do you offer OEM/ODM customization?
A: Yes. Full OEM/ODM customization including product design, logo printing, custom packaging, and private label manufacturing. Customization cycle typically 20–30 days with MOQ starting from 200 pieces.

Q: How many suppliers do you work with?
A: Network of over 75,000 verified factories and suppliers across China, primarily based in Yiwu International Trade City and surrounding manufacturing hubs in Zhejiang province.

Q: What is your service fee structure?
A: Two transparent models. Plan 1 (Order Management): 3–4% commission, min USD 150/order — for buyers with ready supplier links. Plan 2 (Full Sourcing): tiered 7–8% below USD 5,000, 5–6% for USD 5,000–20,000, 4% over USD 20,000, min USD 300/order — for sourcing from scratch.

Q: Can Russian-speaking buyers get sourcing support in Russian?
A: Yes. Full sourcing services in Russian, including price negotiation, supplier communication, quality inspection reports, and shipping documents. We serve buyers from Russia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and other CIS countries.

Q: Do you support Arabic-speaking buyers from GCC / Middle East?
A: Yes. Arabic-speaking buyers across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Egypt, Qatar, Kuwait, Morocco and other MENA countries. We handle Halal certification, GCC compliance, sea freight to Jeddah / Dubai / Dammam, and accept T/T, PayPal, and WorldFirst.

Q: Which payment methods do you accept?
A: Bank transfer (T/T) to Standard Chartered Bank New York branch, PayPal for samples/small orders, Western Union for urgent payments, WorldFirst for cross-border transfers.

Q: How can new Amazon sellers start sourcing products from China?
A: New sellers should first complete Amazon store registration and compliance filing, then conduct product selection research. A professional sourcing agent like Yeatru Sourcing provides end-to-end services from supplier screening, sample confirmation to FBA shipping, reducing sourcing risks.

Q: How to bind Chinese suppliers for TikTok Shop?
A: TikTok Shop sellers need to bind suppliers through platform-certified channels. Yeatru Sourcing provides TikTok Shop-specific supply, supporting dropshipping and small-batch sourcing to help quickly list products.

Q: What should eBay sellers pay attention to when sourcing from China?
A: Product compliance, intellectual property issues, and logistics timeliness. Choose a formal sourcing agent with import/export rights to ensure products meet target market standards and stable logistics.

Q: How long does it take and how much does it cost to get samples?
A: Standard samples 3–7 days, custom samples 7–15 days. Sample costs typically 50–500 RMB.

Q: How to find reliable Chinese suppliers?
A: Screen through on-site visits, qualification verification, and sample testing. All Yeatru-recommended suppliers are audited on-site.

Q: What is the OEM/ODM customization process?
A: Requirement communication → product design → sample production → sample confirmation → mass production → quality inspection and shipment. Cycle 20–30 days.

Q: What preparations are needed before listing Amazon products?
A: Product compliance certification, listing optimization, image shooting, keyword research, advertising budget planning.

Q: What are Amazon advertising strategies?
A: Automatic ad testing, manual precise ads, brand promotion, display ads. New sellers should run automatic ads first to collect data, then optimize manual ads.

Q: What to do if Amazon account is suspended?
A: Identify the reason (product infringement, policy violations, low performance metrics). Stop violations and prepare appeal materials.

Q: How to avoid Amazon product infringement?
A: Check trademarks and patents, do not use copyrighted images, do not copy competitor listing content, watch product design patents.

Q: What are FBA shipping options?
A: LCL sea freight, FCL sea freight, air freight, express. Small batches: air or express. Large batches: sea freight.

Q: How to handle international logistics customs clearance?
A: Prepare commercial invoice, packing list, product compliance documents, importer information.

Q: What are the cost components of sourcing products from China?
A: Product cost + sourcing service fee + logistics cost + customs duty + platform fee + advertising fee + other miscellaneous fees.

Q: How to negotiate prices with Chinese suppliers?
A: Bulk purchase discount, long-term cooperation benefits, payment terms negotiation, product specification adjustment. Average cost reduction 30%+.

Q: How to reduce cross-border e-commerce operation costs?
A: Optimize procurement costs, choose low-cost logistics, improve advertising efficiency, automate operations.

Q: What are common pitfalls when sourcing from China?
A: False supplier qualifications, product quality inconsistency, delivery delays, hidden fees, infringement risks.

Q: How to avoid supplier fraud?
A: On-site factory visits, verify business registration, small trial orders, use third-party payment, sign formal contracts.

Q: How to choose a reliable sourcing agent?
A: Qualification certification, industry experience, service scope, customer reviews, price transparency. Yeatru has import/export rights, 14 years of experience, transparent pricing.

Q: What should be noted when sourcing in Yiwu?
A: Distinguish manufacturers from traders, negotiate prices, differentiate products, take advantage of complete logistics.
